description_en: Queries the details of vulnerabilities detected by image security scans and the list of container images affected by the vulnerabilities
description_zh: 查看镜像安全扫描的漏洞的详情及受漏洞影响容器镜像的信息列表
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-image-vul-list --type cve --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeImageVulList

parameters.help_en:
The language type of the request and response messages. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The type of vulnerability to query. Set the value to cve, which indicates container image vulnerabilities
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的漏洞的类型。固定取值为cve，表示查询容器镜像漏洞
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The UUIDs of asset instances. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资产实例的UUID列表。多个UUID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: uuids

parameters.help_en: The name of the vulnerability to query
parameters.name: name

parameters.example: High severity vulnerability that affects org.eclipse.jetty:jetty-server
parameters.help_en: The alias of the vulnerability to query
parameters.name: alias_name

parameters.help_en:
The fix status of the vulnerability. Valid values:
1: unfixed
4: being fixed
7: fixed
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞的修复状态。取值：
1：未修复
4：修复中
7：修复成功
parameters.name: status_list

parameters.help_en:
The priority level of vulnerability fixing. Valid values:
asap: high-priority vulnerability
later: medium-priority vulnerability
nntf: low-priority vulnerability
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞修复必要性等级。取值：
asap：需尽快修复（通常是高危漏洞）
later：可延后修复（通常是中危漏洞）
nntf：暂可不修复（通常是低危漏洞）
parameters.name: necessity

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the vulnerability has been handled. Valid values:
y: handled
n: not handled
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞是否已处理。取值：
y：已处理
n：未处理
parameters.name: dealed

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return in a paginated query. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: Settings for the number of vulnerabilities to display on each page in a paged query. Default value: 10, which indicates that 10 vulnerabilities are displayed on each page
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的漏洞的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条漏洞
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the container image repository
parameters.name: repo_region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the container image repository
parameters.name: repo_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the container image repository
parameters.name: repo_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the container image repository
parameters.name: repo_name

parameters.help_en: The namespace of the container image repository
parameters.help_zh: 容器镜像仓库的命名空间
parameters.name: repo_namespace

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the asset instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The tag of the container image
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the container image
parameters.name: digest

parameters.help_en: The ID of the container cluster
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The collection of scan ranges
parameters.name: scan_range

parameters.help_en: The name of the cluster
parameters.name: cluster_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the container
parameters.name: container_id

parameters.help_en: The pod
parameters.name: pod

parameters.help_en: The namespace
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The name of the container image
parameters.name: image

parameters.help_en:
The vulnerability tag. Valid values:

AI: vulnerability related to AI components
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞标签，取值：

AI： AI组件相关漏洞
parameters.name: rule_tag

parameters.help_en: The ResourceDirectoryAccountId
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of vulnerabilities displayed on each page in a paged query. Default value: 10
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的漏洞的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条漏洞

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of vulnerabilities returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的漏洞的总数量

AliasName.example: CVE-2018-25010:libwebp up to 1.0.0 ApplyFilter out-of-bounds read

CanFix.description_en:
Indicates whether the vulnerability can be fixed from the console. Valid values:

yes: can be fixed
no: cannot be fixed
CanFix.description_zh:
是否可控制台修复。取值：

yes：可修复
no：不可修复

CanUpdate.description_en:
Indicates whether the software package that causes the vulnerability can be upgraded through Security Center. Valid values:

true: Supported.
false: Not supported
CanUpdate.description_zh:
导致漏洞的软件包是否支持通过云安全中心升级。取值：

true：支持升级
false：不支持升级

ExtendContentJson.description_en: The extended content of the vulnerability information

Os.description_en: The name of the operating system

OsRelease.description_en: The release version of the operating system corresponding to the container image
OsRelease.description_zh: 容器镜像对应的操作系统发行的版本

RpmEntityList.description_en: The list of software packages that cause the vulnerability
RpmEntityList.description_zh: 导致漏洞的软件包的信息列表

items.description_en: The information about the software package that causes the vulnerability
items.description_zh: 导致漏洞的软件包的信息

FullVersion.description_en: The full version number of the software package

Layer.description_en: The SHA256 value of the container image layer digest
Layer.description_zh: 容器镜像层级的摘要的SHA256值

MatchDetail.description_en: The details of the vulnerability match

MatchList.description_en: The list of matched rule details
MatchList.description_zh: 命中的规则的详情列表

items.description_en: The details of matched rules. Multiple rule details are separated by commas (,)
items.description_zh: 命中的规则的详情列表。多个规则的详情之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔

Name.description_en: The name of the software package

Path.description_en: The path of the software that contains the vulnerability
Path.description_zh: 存在漏洞的软件所在的路径

UpdateCmd.description_en: The command to fix the vulnerability

Version.description_en: The version number of the software package

FirstTs.description_en: The timestamp of the first scan. Unit: milliseconds
FirstTs.description_zh: 首次扫描的时间戳，单位为毫秒

ImageDigest.description_en: The unique identifier of the container image

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the asset instance

InternetIp.description_en: The public IP address of the server

IntranetIp.description_en: The private IP address of the server

LastTs.description_en: The timestamp of the latest scan. Unit: milliseconds
LastTs.description_zh: 最新扫描的时间戳，单位为毫秒

Layers.description_en: The list of container image layers

items.description_en: The list of container image layers

MaliciousSource.description_en:
The source of the malicious file. Valid values:

agentless: agentless detection
image: image
container: container
MaliciousSource.description_zh:
恶意文件来源。取值：

agentless：无代理检测
image：镜像
container：容器

ModifyTs.description_en: The timestamp when the vulnerability record was last updated. Unit: milliseconds
ModifyTs.description_zh: 漏洞记录的更新的时间戳，单位为毫秒

Necessity.description_en:
The priority level of vulnerability fixing. Valid values:
asap: high-priority vulnerability
later: medium-priority vulnerability
nntf: low-priority vulnerability
Necessity.description_zh:
漏洞修复必要性等级。取值：
asap：需尽快修复（通常是高危漏洞）
later：可延后修复（通常是中危漏洞）
nntf：暂可不修复（通常是低危漏洞）

Related.description_en: The details of the related vulnerability

RepoName.description_en: The name of the container image repository

RepoNamespace.description_en: The namespace of the container image repository
RepoNamespace.description_zh: 容器镜像仓库的命名空间

RuleTag.description_en:
The vulnerability tag. Valid values:

AI: vulnerability related to AI components
RuleTag.description_zh:
漏洞标签，取值：

AI： AI组件相关漏洞

ScanTime.description_en: The timestamp of the scan. Unit: milliseconds
ScanTime.description_zh: 扫描的时间戳，单位：毫秒

Status.description_en:
The fix status of the vulnerability. Valid values:
1: unfixed
7: fixed
Status.description_zh:
漏洞的修复状态。取值：
1：未修复
7：修复成功

Tag.description_en: The tag of the container image vulnerability

TargetId.description_en: The ID of the scan target

TargetName.description_en: The name of the scan target

TargetType.description_en:
The object type of the scan target. Valid values:

ECS_IMAGE: image.
ECS_SNAPSHOT: snapshot
TargetType.description_zh:
扫描对象类型。取值：

ECS_IMAGE：镜像。
ECS_SNAPSHOT：快照

Type.description_en: The type of vulnerability queried. The value is fixed as cve, which indicates container image vulnerabilities
Type.description_zh: 本次查询的漏洞的类型。固定取值为cve，表示查询容器镜像漏洞
